question: The Karnataka Khadi and Gramodyoga Samyukta Sangha (KKGSS), the only unit legally permitted to manufacture the tricolour flag out of pure khadi, is located in which place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengeri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Karnataka Khadi and Gramodyoga Samyukta Sangha (KKGSS)** is the only organization in India that is legally authorized to manufacture the **tricolour national flag** out of pure khadi cloth.
 
• KKGSS is located in **Bengeri, Hubli**, in the state of Karnataka, India.
 
• The **Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS)** has laid strict guidelines for the production of the national flag, and KKGSS adheres to these standards meticulously.
 
• The flags are made from two types of khadi fabric: **khadi cotton** for the flag and **khadi silk** for the emblem, ensuring the highest quality and authenticity.
 
• The unit in Bengeri is responsible for the entire production process, from spinning and weaving khadi to dyeing and stitching the flags, ensuring compliance with the **Flag Code of India**.
